fact: The strategy report (letters dated 27 April 2023 and 24 October 2023) says the digital birth certificate, under the Ministry of Health, has no slot for a NIN for those just born or under 18, and shows no direct correlation and data synchronization between the Immigration Department and the Ministry of Health.
title: Gambia National Digital Identity Strategy: Strategy Report
publisher: Ministry of Communication and Digital Economy, The Gambia (report by Bharat B Nanawati)
